name: moving-circle-therapy-backend
description: Backend API for the Moving Circle Therapy mobile app

scripts.db:migrate: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const fs=require('fs'); const {Pool}=require('pg'); const pool=new Pool({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL}); pool.query(fs.readFileSync('sql/schema.sql','utf8')).then(()=>{console.log('schema applied');pool.end();}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);pool.end();process.exit(1);});"
